questions.q: which statuses can an account be in?
questions.answer: pending, active, locked, closed, trial, paused, archived. The later CHECK adds archived.

questions.q: what values are allowed for shipment_stage?
questions.answer: queued, sent, delivered; delivered is added in a later migration.

questions.q: does the retired_devices table still exist?
questions.answer: It was created with online/offline states, then dropped in 030_retirement.sql.
status with recorded/sealed values, plus retained_until. This is not public.accounts.

questions.q: where is the maintenance_reason column on app.device_state added?
questions.answer: 050_devices.sql adds maintenance_reason. Unquoted APP.DEVICE_STATE folds to the same identity as app."device_state"; quoted uppercase identifiers would stay distinct.

questions.q: what tiers are allowed in plans now?
questions.answer: free, pro, enterprise. Unqualified plans and public.plans identify the same default-schema subject.
level with info/error values, plus actor_id; not trace_id, which belongs to schema event table log.

questions.q: what columns does the log table in the event schema contain?
questions.answer: level with debug/trace values, plus trace_id; not actor_id.

questions.q: what values can the processing_state enum have?
questions.answer: waiting, running, finished. The table with the same name is a different object and is dropped.

questions.q: does the processing_state table still exist?
questions.answer: No. The table was dropped by 090_table.sql; the enum type is distinct.

questions.q: what is the newest migration changing lexical_order?
questions.answer: 9_patch.sql, which drops lexical_order. The issue's bytewise path ordering puts 9 after 10, regardless of numeric prefixes or ingestion order.

questions.q: where is quoted_case_reason added to app."Device_State"?
questions.answer: 055_quoted_case.sql adds quoted_case_reason to the case-sensitive quoted table Device_State, not the lowercase table device_state.
